related.title: GraphSAGE：鄰居取樣與計算樹
related.titleEn: GraphSAGE: neighbor sampling and computation trees
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付鄰居遮罩、權重表及擾動測試。；5與8正確，非法鄰居擾動不影響輸出，合法鄰居變化符合.75靈敏度。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver neighbor masks, weights and perturbation tests.; Results match, nonneighbors have no effect and valid-neighbor sensitivity is.75.
related.difference: 畫seed、四個一跳及每支三個二跳節點，給重複鄰居同一ID。；17與25正確，唯一節點與實例分開，驗證label不進特徵。
related.differenceEn: Draw one seed,four first-hop neighbors and three second-hop children each; use identical IDs for duplicates.; Counts match, unique nodes and instances are separated and validation labels never enter features.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 鄰居logit為0與ln3時，softmax權重1/4與3/4；只在合法鄰居集合正規化。；教學鄰居特徵2與6；改第二特徵10，權重固定作聚合敏感度。；y=.25×2+.75×6=5；改10時8。
無重複的兩跳展開最多1+s1+s1s2個節點實例；共享鄰居會減少唯一節點數。；教學一個seed，s1=4,s2=3；改s2=5。；N=1+4+4×3=17；改後1+4+4×5=25。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Neighbor logits0 and ln3 yield weights1/4 and3/4; normalize only over valid neighbors.; Teaching features2 and6; change the second to10 while freezing weights for sensitivity.; y=.25×2+.75×6=5; changing to10 gives8.
A disjoint two-hop expansion contains1+s1+s1s2 node instances; shared neighbors reduce unique nodes.; Teaching one seed,s1=4,s2=3, then s2=5.; N=1+4+4×3=17; changed N=25.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Dropout：期望守恆與隨機變異
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付鄰居遮罩、權重表及擾動測試。；5與8正確，非法鄰居擾動不影響輸出，合法鄰居變化符合.75靈敏度。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver neighbor masks, weights and perturbation tests.; Results match, nonneighbors have no effect and valid-neighbor sensitivity is.75.
related.difference: 列mask0與1兩種結果、各自機率及縮放；把保留率與丟棄率分開。；變異1.3333333與4正確，兩案期望2且eval無額外縮放。
related.differenceEn: List both mask outcomes,probabilities and scaling, distinguishing keep from drop probabilities.; Variances match,both means are2 and evaluation adds no scaling.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 鄰居logit為0與ln3時，softmax權重1/4與3/4；只在合法鄰居集合正規化。；教學鄰居特徵2與6；改第二特徵10，權重固定作聚合敏感度。；y=.25×2+.75×6=5；改10時8。
反向縮放dropout為y=mask×x/(1−p)，E[y]=x，Var[y]=x²p/(1−p)。；教學x2，丟棄率p.25；改p.5，獨立Bernoulli遮罩。；Var=4×.25/.75=1.3333333；p.5時4。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Neighbor logits0 and ln3 yield weights1/4 and3/4; normalize only over valid neighbors.; Teaching features2 and6; change the second to10 while freezing weights for sensitivity.; y=.25×2+.75×6=5; changing to10 gives8.
Inverted dropout uses y=mask x/(1−p), preserving mean x with variance x²p/(1−p).; Teaching x2,drop probability.25 then.5,independent Bernoulli masks.; Variance=4×.25/.75=1.3333333; p.5 gives4.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
